item.text:
Fixed `TopModule.sv` and sanity-checked it with a quick `iverilog` simulation.

SYMPTOM: `data` did not cycle through `001011`; it stayed stuck because the pattern register never advanced.

ROOT CAUSE: `TopModule.sv:13` used `q <= {q[5], q[4:0]};`, which reconstructs `q` in the same order instead of rotating it. As a result, `q` stayed at `6'b001011` forever, so `data <= q[5]` kept outputting the same bit.

FIX: Changed `TopModule.sv:13` to `q <= {q[4:0], q[5]};` so the 6-bit pattern rotates each clock and `data` outputs the repeating sequence `001011`.
